title: Agent definition frontmatter (MAT-17)
description: Schema for validating YAML frontmatter in agent definition Markdown files. v1.1 adds variant_of and specialization for agent variants.

name.description: Unique agent identifier (lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens).

description.description: Human-readable description of the agent's purpose.

role.description: Agent role: orchestrator (plan/route), worker (execute tasks), executor (constrained ops).

cli.description: CLI tool binding (must match MAT-16 agent config).

variant_of.description: Name of the base agent this variant extends. Base agent must exist in agents/ directory.

specialization.description: Variant specialization metadata for Crew routing and Swarm dispatch.

domain.description: Primary domain: frontend, backend, devops, data, security, mobile

tags.description: Free-form capability tags for Crew routing queries

allowed_mat_ops.description: MAT-2 operations this agent can perform. Omit for no restrictions.

tools.description: Tools the agent has access to.
